meta.title: A counter offer on a non-existent bid does not crash
gaps: the documented correct behaviour is a refusal, but the case checks only that the app does not crash (it records today's behaviour)

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the “counter the vendor's price” request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
